node.title: Re^3: What do we have to do to resuscitate micro Perl? I want Circuit Perl NOW!
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Why Perl 2 in particular? Where are these sources kept? I tried finding the source with no luck.

It's all [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/releases/tag/perl-2.0|in the same repository].

I also tried building Microperl in 5.30 and it doesn't build on my Mac.

Microperl has been broken for quite a while, IIRC sometime since like 5.12-5.16. [mod://perl5180delta#Future-Deprecations|perl5180delta] says "microperl, long broken and of unclear present purpose, will be removed."
